system.description: Once per round when you or an ally is hit by an enemy attack, spend 10 MP to parry with a weapon whose range is opposite the attack's; the attack becomes an Opposed Check using the enemy's roll versus your weapon's accuracy formula. On success, choose: the attack deals (SL x 3) less damage before Affinities, or the enemy suffers slow (ignoring immunities). On a critical, choose both.
